adjudication.rationale: In `embeddable-host.js.es6` `categoryId` defaults to `null` for new hosts and `save()` sends `props.category_id = this.get('categoryId')` (null). The server normalizes blank `category_id` to `SiteSetting.uncategorized_category_id` in `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController#save_host`, but on success the client does `host.set('category', Discourse.Category.findById(this.get('categoryId')));`. When `categoryId` is null, this sets `host.category` to `undefined`, so `{{category-badge host.category}}` will be blank/stale until a reload or until category is rehydrated another way. The defect is directly visible from the diff.
